cond_0001.intro: This job is responsible for technical and operational support of cloud infrastructure resources in Microsoft Azure and Oracle cloud. This role provides support to ensure the highest levels of systems and cloud infrastructure availability. The Cloud Systems Engineer will work closely with Cloud Engineering Leads to deliver standard, automated deployments via code and pipelines. This role will work with Software Engineering, Data Services, Data Scientists, and Solutions Architects to develop and document requirements for application and PaaS service configuration, testing, validation, and deployments. The Cloud Systems Engineer is responsible for platforms and installed systems in order to meet business needs, deadlines, and objectives for regulatory compliance.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists in strategizing Azure/ Oracle Cloud Engineering execution
Develops and implements standards and best practices as it relates to cloud solutions
Leads efforts to provision infrastructure using infrastructure as code tooling. Leverages automation to monitor and orchestrate client environments
Implements Cloud standards, DevOps / CICD tool chain and Standard Operating Environment (SOE). Supports business requirements by conducting business needs assessments and analysis
Keeps up with patches and updates to enable new functionality and address vulnerabilities. Conducts research on emerging technologies in support of cloud and infrastructure development efforts and recommends technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and infrastructure flexibility. Works with Kubernetes, Docker, and other container technologies
Deploys of all Azure PaaS services (API, AKS, AppService, FrontDoor etc.)
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years with Bachelor's degree
2 Years as an Azure cloud engineer focusing on IaC and PaaS Services (AKS, AppService etc.)
Solid understanding of Azure public cloud platform
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent troubleshooting skills
Knowledge of software development life cycle
Knowledge of infrastructure management within a cloud environment
Proficiency in modern software architecture using CI/CD, DevOps, Scalability, API first strategy and etc.
Preferred Requirements
Strong communications / interpersonal skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Broad knowledge of cloud computing concepts and solutions
Knowledge of programming languages and web based technologies
Knowledge of cloud delivery models
Knowledge of web services, API Gateway, Elastic/Network Load Balancers

The focus is on ensuring high availability of systems and cloud infrastructure. The Cloud Systems Engineer will coordinate with Cloud Engineering Leads to deliver standard, automated deployments via code and pipelines, and will interface with Software Engineering, Data Services, Data Scientists, and Solutions Architects to develop and document requirements for application and PaaS service configuration, testing, validation, and deployments. The role is responsible for platforms and installed systems to meet business needs, deadlines, and objectives for regulatory compliance.
cond_0313.responsibilities:
Assists in strategizing Azure/Oracle Cloud Engineering execution
Develops and implements standards and best practices for cloud solutions
Leads efforts to provision infrastructure using infrastructure as code tooling
Leverages automation to monitor and orchestrate client environments
Implements Cloud standards, DevOps/CICD tool chain and Standard Operating Environment (SOE)
Supports business requirements by conducting business needs assessments and analysis
Keeps up with patches and updates to enable new functionality and address vulnerabilities
Conducts research on emerging technologies in support of cloud and infrastructure development efforts and recommends technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and infrastructure flexibility
Works with Kubernetes, Docker, and other container technologies
Deploys all Azure PaaS services (API, AKS, AppService, FrontDoor, etc.)

Minimum Requirements
2+ Years with Bachelor's degree
2 Years as an Azure cloud engineer focusing on IaC and PaaS Services (AKS, AppService, etc.)
Solid understanding of Azure public cloud platform
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Excellent troubleshooting skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Proficiency in modern software architecture using CI/CD, DevOps, Scalability, API first strategy, etc.

Knowledge of software development life cycle
Knowledge of programming languages and web-based technologies
Broad knowledge of cloud computing concepts and solutions
Knowledge of infrastructure management within a cloud environment
